purpose: Give the front room a distinct shop exterior and align the owner's half-body presentation with the new counter.
prompt: Warm hand-painted gouache Japanese udon shop exterior in spring, vertical mobile scene. Blank timber shop sign, four terracotta noren panels, shoji entrance, low wood and green storefront counter, lanterns, flowers and a mossy stone lane in the foreground. Match the existing cozy room backgrounds. No characters, letters, logos or second serving tray.
integration: layouts/front.json layers the dynamic Vietnamese sign and noren letters over the art, places the half-body owner behind the wood ledge, and keeps the existing entrance hotspot.
